_comment: claude-awesome-status config. JSON has no comment syntax and this file's parser does NOT strip '//' comments — a stray // line makes the whole file unparseable (silently: it just falls back to defaults). Use _-prefixed keys for notes instead, like this one; unknown keys are always ignored.

style_options._comment: Only 'solid' reads style_options.color; other styles ignore it.

thresholds._comment: Any threshold you omit keeps its built-in default.

priority._comment: 1-99 = droppable if max_rows forces a trim (higher survives longer); 100 = pinned, never dropped.

segments._comment: Custom segments. command as an array execs directly (safest, no shell); command as a string, or inline, runs through bash -c. There's no privilege difference between the two -- inline just means the code lives here instead of an external script. THIS FILE IS EXECUTABLE CODE: treat it like your .bashrc.
